title: resolve input
description: §6.2 — resolve(address, profile?) -> MailCoordinates. A release artifact, not a specification schema: §18.5 fixes the fourteen files in spec/schemas/ and the tools' inputs are not among them. T-P15-4 is what binds it — the tool schemas served by every transport in the release are identical after canonicalization.

address.description: The typed address. Well-formed for at least one profile the implementation supports, or RESOLVE_UNSUPPORTED_ADDRESS.

profile.description: §9's profile identifier. Optional; when given, the address must be of that profile's kind, or RESOLVE_PROFILE_MISMATCH.
